name: Pokemon Classic
summary: Step back into the Kanto you love and set forth on a new journey with your Pikachu! In this fan-made Pokemon Yellow remake, Trainers of the original 151 Pokemon will go on an adventure covering familiar ground and discover new stories and events to tell. Packed with many modern features of newer Pokemon games and QoL improvements, this Gameboy Advance romhack puts a fresh perspective on your quest to be the very best like no one ever was.
